identity.title: Glen Scrivener vs Michael Shermer || EPIC DEBATE
identity.dateBasis: Premier Unbelievable published the original debate article on 25 October 2024; the supplied Glen Scrivener upload is a July 2025 reupload linking the original video. The recorded event is identified with its original publication year, not the reupload or assessment year.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Named two-guest introduction, explicit handoffs, stable first-person position ownership, named moderator Vince Vitale, and complete caption review.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: All 2,184 caption events cover opening promotion, host introduction, the full discussion and outro. Assessment starts at the first primary answer, 02:10.720, and ends with Shermer’s last primary sentence at about 1:20:14; its rolling caption ends at 1:20:17.440. The 1.52-second caption overrun beyond nominal recording duration is an ASR tail.
content.captionCaution: Automatic captions contain errors in names, technical vocabulary and biblical references. Do not attribute those errors to a participant. Material ambiguity needs audio verification before it can ground a rating.

participants.dyadicGateMeaning: Exactly two scored primary speakers under explicit editor-approved-moderator-context-v1 authority; the original recording is not certified strictly dyadic.

editorApprovedScope.userApproval: The user answered “Yes.” to the explicit question: “May I score only Shermer and Scrivener, using the moderator’s questions as context and evaluating their replies, with this exception clearly disclosed?” The preceding request explained that host advocacy exceeded the automatic 5% allowance.
editorApprovedScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: By explicit editorial approval, this assessment scores only Michael Shermer and Glen Scrivener across the complete substantive exchange. Moderator Vince Vitale supplies substantive philosophical questions and challenges beyond the ordinary incidental-host allowance; his contributions remain context, and the debaters’ own replies remain eligible for assessment. No argument or score is assigned to a debater merely because Vitale advances it. Unequal questioning is considered when selecting moves and evaluating opportunities to respond. This is a recording-specific exception, not an assessment of a strictly two-speaker recording.
editorApprovedScope.scopeInterpretation: Both speakers allow moral conduct without belief in God. The contested issues include moral grounding, the scope of equal human worth, and the historical and continuing role of Christianity. Scrivener also allows some objective or prosocial morality without Jesus; do not invent his denial of every secular moral truth.

participants.questionHandling: All moderator claims and question premises remain context only. A primary speaker’s own adoption, qualification or answer is eligible on its own merits; never transfer the host’s argument to Scrivener or manufacture a selected primary target for a host-only challenge.

duplicateAudit.method: Searched both supplied and original upload IDs, canonical URLs, speaker pairing and question across production records and standalone registry.
